problem: Prove BeBee's central restoration promise in the first production meadow: existing pollination/progression actions must visibly change the same world from dormant through recovery to restored, remain understandable without a modal tutorial or extra restoration action, stay readable with the HUD hidden, survive reload, and retain P0-P3 runtime behavior on desktop and touch.

decision.rationale: Keep restoration as the automatic world payoff of the already validated movement-through pollination loop. Derive the stage from stable completed patch IDs rather than persist a duplicate meadow-stage field, and change several visible channels together: ground mix, detail density and ambient life, with a bounded non-blocking final accent. Exact-head Chromium evidence shows the dormant/mid/restored ladder, HUD-hidden before/after, reload safety, independent deterministic fixtures and retained P1-P3 behavior.

selected_references.name: Terra Nil multi-channel ecosystem transformation
selected_references.selection_reason: Closest structural reference for making restoration legible through the state of the environment itself.
selected_references.observed_behavior: The product premise and official presentation show barren/dead terrain becoming grassland, forest, habitat and a visibly living ecosystem.
selected_references.inference: BeBee P4 should not rely on a completion label or recolored flower alone; ground state, vegetation/detail density and signs of life should move together.

selected_references.name: The Gunk in-world corruption/regrowth payoff
selected_references.selection_reason: Useful direct reference for the payoff occurring in the same traversed space where the player acted.
selected_references.observed_behavior: The official description frames removal of corruption as restoring nature and transforming the world around the player.
selected_references.inference: BeBee should apply restoration automatically in the gameplay meadow after pollination completion, not cut to a results surface or add a second restore verb.

selected_references.name: Flower movement-linked landscape revival
selected_references.selection_reason: Supports a low-instruction relationship between movement and visible environmental reaction.
selected_references.observed_behavior: The player carries petals through landscapes and sees them come alive as part of traversal.
selected_references.inference: Retain BeBee's movement-through pollination verb and make restoration a consequence rather than a confirmation interaction.

anti_pattern.observation: A surfaced App Store review criticizes some environmental repair tasks for collapsing into a single icon tap instead of letting the player perform the meaningful activity; this is anecdotal user evidence, not a universal product finding.
anti_pattern.lesson: Do not add a hammer/restore/confirm action after BeBee pollination. The pollination traversal is already the meaningful activity; the world should react automatically.

official_docs.verified_constraint: The current Defold GUI API supports creating box/text nodes and updating node color, position, size and enabled state at runtime, so P4 can express the authored restoration ladder inside the existing renderer without a parallel scene system.

GUI owns presentation while gameplay/domain state remains separate; P4 therefore derives restoration status in a pure domain module/data model instead of persisting or authoring campaign truth in GUI nodes.
Persistence continues through the existing protected versioned storage abstraction. P4 adds no new persisted meadow-stage field and therefore requires no save-schema version increase.
